subject: Game Theory
title: Google's Ad Auctions
description: A short lesson to help you apply Google's Ad Auctions.

hook.text: Every Google search triggers an instant auction. Advertisers bid on keywords in milliseconds.

buildup.text: Google uses a generalized second-price auction: winners pay just enough to beat the next bidder.

discovery.text: This encourages truthful bidding. Advertisers don't need to game the system—honesty is optimal.

twist.text: Google also factors in ad quality. A lower bid with a better ad can beat a higher bid with a worse one.

climax.text: This auction runs billions of times daily, generating over $200 billion per year in ad revenue.

punchline.text: Every search is an invisible auction.

quiz.question: What type of auction does Google use for ads?
